description_en: Queries the execution instances of a media workflow
description_zh: 遍历媒体工作流执行实例
name: ListMediaWorkflowExecutions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media workflow whose execution instances you want to query. To obtain the workflow ID, you can log on to the ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) console and choose Workflows > Workflow Settings
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询实例的媒体工作流ID。可以通过MPS控制台 > 工作流管理 > 工作流设置获取
parameters.name: media_workflow_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the media workflow. To obtain the workflow name, you can log on to the MPS console and choose Workflows > Workflow Settings
parameters.help_zh: 媒体工作流名称。可以通过MPS控制台 > 工作流管理 > 工作流设置获取
parameters.name: media_workflow_name

parameters.help_en: The Object Storage Service (OSS) URL of the input file of the media workflow. The URL complies with RFC 3986 and is encoded in UTF-8, with reserved characters being percent-encoded. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html
parameters.help_zh: 媒体工作流指定的输入文件OSS Bucket。遵循RFC 3986（UTF8编码，并对保留字符进行URLEncode）。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html
parameters.name: input_file_url

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. The value is a UUID that contains 32 characters. When you request the first page of query results, leave the NextPageToken parameter empty. When you request more query results, specify the value of the NextPageToken parameter returned in the query results on the previous page
parameters.help_zh: 下一页标识，32位UUID。请求第一页时，NextPageToken为空；请求后续文件时需传入前一页查询结果中的NextPageToken值
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of media workflow execution instances to return. Valid values: `[1,100]`. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 最大可返回的媒体工作流执行实例数。取值范围：`[1,100]`，默认值：10
parameters.name: maximum_page_size

MediaWorkflowExecution.description_en: The details of the media workflows

items.description_en: The details of the media workflow

Activity.description_en: The activities that are executed in the media workflow

items.description_en: The details of the media workflow activity

Code.description_en:
The error code returned if the request failed.

The specific error code appears if the state of the activity is Fail.
This parameter is not returned if the state of the activity is Success
Code.description_zh:
错误码。

如果活动状态是Fail，会给出具体的错误码。

如果活动状态是Success，此参数不返回

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the activity

JobId.description_en: The ID of the job generated when the activity is executed. We recommend that you keep this ID for subsequent operation calls
JobId.description_zh: 活动执行时生成的作业ID。建议您保存此ID便于后续调用其他接口时使用

MNSMessageResult.description_en: The message sent by Message Service (MNS) to notify the user of the job result
MNSMessageResult.description_zh: MNS通知用户作业完成结果

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the job failed. If the job was successful, this parameter is not returned
ErrorCode.description_zh: 执行失败时错误码。如果执行成功则不返回此参数
ErrorCode.example: The Topic/Queue config is empty, not send message

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the job failed. If the job was successful, this parameter is not returned
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 执行失败时错误信息。如果执行成功则不返回此参数

MessageId.description_en: The ID of the success message. If the job failed, this parameter is not returned
MessageId.description_zh: 执行成功时消息ID。如果执行失败则不返回此参数

Message.description_en:
The error message returned if the request failed.

The detailed error message appears if the state of the activity is Fail.
This parameter is not returned if the state of the activity is Success
Message.description_zh:
错误信息。

如果活动状态是Fail，会给出详细的错误描述信息。
如果活动状态是Success，此参数不返回

Name.description_en:
The name of the media workflow activity.

The name of an activity in a media workflow is unique
Name.description_zh:
媒体工作流活动名称。

在同一个工作流中活动的名称是唯一的

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the activity

State.description_en:
The status of the activity. Valid values:

Running: The activity is being executed.
Fail: The activity failed to be executed.
Skipped: The activity was skipped.
Success: The activity was successfully executed.

For example, the high-definition and standard-definition transcoding activities are to be run after the analysis activity is complete. The system determines the activity to run based on the analysis result. If the definition of the input video content is insufficient, the high-definition transcoding activity may be skipped
State.description_zh:
活动状态。可取值：

Running：活动执行中。

Fail：活动执行失败。

Skipped：活动被跳过。
Success：执行成功。

例如：分析活动之后有高清、标清两个转码活动，会根据实际分析的结果来决策，如果原视频内容清晰度不够，高清的转码活动就可能被跳过

Type.description_en: The type of the media workflow activity. Valid values: Start, Snapshot, Transcode, Analysis, and Report. For more information, see [Methods supported for media workflows]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68494.html）
Type.description_zh: 媒体工作流活动类型。可取值：Start活动、Snapshot活动、Transcode活动、Analysis活动、Report活动。更多信息请参见[媒体工作流活动介绍]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2542772.html）

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the media workflow was created

Input.description_en: The custom data of the media workflow
Input.description_zh: 媒体工作流的用户自定义数据

InputFile.description_en: The information about the storage location of the input file of the media workflow in OSS
InputFile.description_zh: 媒体工作流的输入OSS Bucket

Bucket.description_en: The name of the OSS bucket in which the input media file is stored

Location.description_en: The OSS region in which the input file resides

Object.description_en: The name of the OSS object that is used as the input media file

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the media file. A media file contains all the information about a media workflow
MediaId.description_zh: 媒体ID。媒体工作流生成的所有信息都属于这个媒体ID

MediaWorkflowId.description_en: The ID of the media workflow

Name.description_en: The name of the media workflow

RunId.description_en: The ID of the execution instance

State.description_en:
The status of the media workflow. Valid values:

running: The execution is in progress.
Completed: The execution is complete.

A value of Completed indicates that the execution is complete. For the information about whether each activity, such as Transcode or Snapshot, is successful, check the status of the activity.

Fail: The execution failed.
Success: The execution was successful
State.description_zh:
工作流状态。可取值：

Running：执行中。

Completed：执行完成。

Completed仅表示工作流执行完成，每个活动（转码、截图等）是否成功要看每个活动具体的状态值。

Fail：执行失败。

Success：执行成功

NextPageToken.description_en: The returned value of NextPageToken is a pagination token, which can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
